One Lever Labs ZonedIn Web Extension

ZonedIn Web Extension Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 16, 2026

ZonedIn is a Chrome extension that provides a focus timer, task list, and optional website blocking during a running focus session.

Information ZonedIn stores

ZonedIn stores your focus-session settings and status, focus tasks, and blocked-site list using Chrome’s local extension storage. This information stays in your browser and is not sent to ZonedIn’s developer or to an external server.

Website access and navigation

ZonedIn requests access to YouTube to detect YouTube Shorts navigation and redirect Shorts during a running focus session. If you add a custom blocked site, ZonedIn requests access to that domain and its subdomains. During a running session, matching visits are redirected to a local page in the extension. Custom sites are not blocked when a session has not started, is paused, or has ended.

Navigation checks and redirects are handled by Chrome and the extension. ZonedIn does not use content scripts to read or change the contents of web pages, and does not send browsing activity to an external service.

You can decline a site-access request or revoke granted access in Chrome’s extension settings. Blocking for that site will then be unavailable.

Data sharing and sale

ZonedIn does not sell, share, or transfer your stored tasks, session data, or blocked-site list to the developer or third parties. The extension does not include advertising or analytics.

Data deletion and control

You can remove tasks and blocked sites from the extension. You can end a focus session at any time. You can revoke site access through Chrome’s extension settings. Removing the extension removes its locally stored extension data according to Chrome’s behavior.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the updated version will be published at the same URL with a revised effective date.
